description: The most exclusive Polperro dining experience. The Cellar Table seats 6–8 guests in the private dining room below the winery. Five-course Chef's Menu rooted in provenance and seasonality paired with the latest Polperro and Even Keel cuvée releases. Sculptural lighting and intimate tablescape designed for lingering conversation. Available Saturday evenings.
priceRange: AUD 295 per person (Chef's Menu with matched wines)
suitableFor: Adults 18+; couples; special occasions; serious foodies
accessibilityNotes: Private room accessible — check with venue for specific needs
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill Brewery; Stonier Wines; Foxeys Hangout; Red Hill Truffles
suggestedItineraryPairing: Book Cellar Table on a winter Saturday; pair with a morning truffle hunt or afternoon at Red Hill Brewery
